column3: ＠T_Commander\nWell then, allow me to introduce myself again. I'm Ikoma Aoi of Colorful Bouquet.\nI'll be counting on you.
...This might not be the right moment for it, but I wonder if Amatsu is all right?
Still, having every famous team in the academy gathered in one place is quite a sight.
I heard the temporary base would be tents... but it's far more put together than I expected.
Haah... This is bad... I think I'm only just now starting to get antsy...

＠Rami_K\n...True. We still haven't confirmed anything about the world outside the academy, and here we are already setting off for Serenosia Island.
I want to believe that it will be all right...
I don't think we need to be so pessimistic, do we? Going by what I see on SNS, it doesn't look like much damage was done, and the uproar was centered on the academy.
...Yeah. I'm sure it will be fine.
Of course, we won't know until we actually see it.

column3: Could it be that you still haven't done a Limit Break!?
Limit Breaks use “Style Cards”.<LF>You can get Style Cards by obtaining students you already own from the gacha and elsewhere!
To make the students one step stronger, a Limit Break is required!<LF>Let's try a Limit Break right away!
The Limit Break will be performed using the items below
A Limit Break raises rarity and stats!<LF>It also raises the level cap by 4 tiers, so when growth feels capped, go for a Limit Break!
Ding! She grew a whole lot!<LF>Take your newly polished comrade out on a quest♪
Ding! This is where Pico explains!<LF>No, please let Pico do the explaining!!!!
The vast Maze still holds plenty of unexplored areas!<LF>That's why the route is never the same twice!!
You'll battle Maze Shifters while exploring,<LF>and if you wipe them out safely you can obtain <color=#b500f8>Tatsumiya Ore</color>!!
There is still so much unsolved inside the Maze,<LF>so here's mystery item number one! A Relic that shows its true worth only inside the Maze!!
When you find a Relic along the way, the super-high-performance AI identifies its effect!<LF>There are all kinds of effects, so choose ones that give you an edge as you advance!
Once you've reached a certain depth, collect your Tatsumiya Ore and come back, all right?<LF>Staying inside the Maze for a long time is dangerous!!
By trading Tatsumiya Ore you can <color=#ff1c0b>obtain items that enhance student skills</color> or <color=#ff1c0b>upgrade MG parts</color>, pushing your stats even higher!
Oh, right! Starting tomorrow, the Student Council will hand out daily rewards<LF>based on the deepest area you've reached, just for visiting Maze Exploration every day♪
Rewards get more lavish as you advance through areas,<LF>so keep exploring and aim for deeper areas!
Lastly! I have something important to tell you!
It is your will that carves open the abyss. All units, begin your dive!
As the Student Council President said earlier,<LF>inside the Maze the students' levels are limited by your Commander Rank!
The Maze is a special environment, so please don't forget that the Master's command<LF>is extremely important!!
That said, you won't be going deep right from the start,<LF>so begin by testing yourself in the shallow areas♪
<line-height=2.000em>The Maze entrance――the “Portal”.<LF>Seeing it like this again, it's a huge place.
Challenging the deepest part of your unlocked areas from the start is<LF>extremely dangerous, so please start from Area 1!
<line-height=2.000em>Of course it is! After all, an MG passes through here～!
<line-height=2.000em>What are you doing in a place like this,<LF><noparse>Dreamer</noparse>-san.
<line-height=2.000em>You can't enter the Maze in the flesh, you know.
<line-height=2.000em>I know. I still barely know anything about this academy,<LF>so I'm looking around the place.
<line-height=2.000em>Everyone heads into Maze Exploration from here, right...<LF>to get Tatsumiya Ore.
<line-height=2.000em>The more you dig, the more the students rake in～!<LF>The more you hand over to the academy, the bigger your rewards!
<line-height=2.000em>That said, the assigned areas are fixed, so it's not as if<LF>you can dig as much as you like.
<line-height=2.000em>And even inside your assigned area, how far you can go ties directly to the team's――<LF>especially to the skill of whoever commands it.
<line-height=2.000em>From commanding battles to choosing exploration routes,<LF>every single decision affects the whole team.
<line-height=2.000em>I will take my leave here, then. I look forward to you continuing<LF>to fulfill your role as an instructing commander.

Tatsumiya Ore is basically all managed by the Student Council,<LF>so please use every last bit of it♪
The daily skill enhancement items are precious!<LF>There is also a daily purchase limit, so trade for them every day♪
An item needed to enhance students' skills.\nA tablet recording the basic training content needed to raise their abilities.
Enhancing Type Equipment raises the abilities of<LF>every character that belongs to that type!
Each part boosts a different parameter,<LF>so raise the parameters you want your characters to grow!
Raising Mining Efficiency here increases<LF>the amount of each reward you get from the regular Mining feature!
It builds up day after day,<LF>so even a tiny increase matters!

Mystery item number two: the Artifact!<LF>It mysteriously grants effects only inside the Maze,<LF>and the principle behind it is shrouded in mystery...

That's where Artifacts come in!<LF>Think of them as a kind of charm!
